name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A control for a single on/off/indeterminate value. Pair with an external Label (via id/htmlFor) laid out as a flex row rather than passing label text as children. `CheckboxGroup` gathers several under one label and a `value` array (react-aria `CheckboxGroup`; each `Checkbox` takes a `value`). `CheckboxCard` is a choice card: the whole card is the checkbox, its children are the content (an `IconTile`, `FieldContent` with `FieldTitle` and `FieldDescription`) and a square indicator sits at the end; selected cards take a `primary` tint, hovered ones `accent`.

meta.origin: shadcn/ui, style: aria-nova (base: react-aria-components). Pair with an external Label via id/htmlFor — Checkbox's own children slot is for a custom indicator override, not label text.
